method: Historical mechanical chinook replay using Clackamas River near Oregon City, OR USGS 14211010 daily mean discharge, Clackamas River near Oregon City — measured water temperature USGS 14211010 daily mean measured water temperature, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to Measured Oregon City flow and temperature support the lower reach only; River Mill is the species endpoint. This is conditional responsiveness, not movement or abundance. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
